$comment: Mcp-Name and Mcp-Param-* header values (SEP-2243 as applied by events.mdx:736-775). A value that is plain visible ASCII (space and interior tab allowed) without leading or trailing whitespace is sent as is; any other value (empty, non-ASCII, control characters, surrounding whitespace, or a value that already looks like a sentinel) is sent as =?base64?<standard base64 of UTF-8>?=. Which values need the sentinel was labelled from the transport rules; the base64 was computed with Buffer. `undecodable` lists received values a server rejects with 400 / -32020.
